snippet.title: PUNCHBALL Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey guys, I recently completed my degree in game design and am announcing my first indie game project! I hope that my GD fans and friends follow me on my game design journey as you have all already been a big part of it.

Get ready to race against time in PUNCHBALL! Use cybernetic arms to grab and punch through fast paced and challenging levels in this adrenaline-fueled 3D platformer.

Watch for the release of PUNCHBALL this fall!

Trailer music: Fuzzeke - Without a Care 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xVB0dFL5OZk

For business enquiries email: lucasmccreadygames@gmail.com
